title: Add subtract(a, b) function with unit test
description: Implement a subtract(a, b) function in backend/app.py alongside the existing add(a, b) function, following the same coding style and conventions. Add a corresponding unit test that mirrors the structure and style of the existing test for add(a, b), verifying subtract's correctness with representative cases (e.g. positive numbers, negative numbers, zero).
acceptance_criteria: backend/app.py contains a subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b
subtract(a, b) follows the same style/signature conventions as the existing add(a, b) function
A unit test for subtract(a, b) exists in the same test location/style as the existing add(a, b) test
The new unit test covers at least positive, negative, and zero-value cases
All existing and new unit tests pass successfully
